import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc
# 64-deep nested struct chain: L0 contains L1 contains ... L59 contains Leaf
decls = []
DEPTH = 58
for i in range(DEPTH):
    decls.append({"name": "L%d" % i, "kind": "struct", "fields": [["next", "L%d" % (i + 1)] if i + 1 < DEPTH else ["next", "Leaf"]]})
decls.append({"name": "Leaf", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["v", "N"], ["w", "Big"]]})
decls.append({"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 16})
decls.append({"name": "Big", "kind": "int", "bits": 64})
decls.append({"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Leaf", "size": 4096})
decls.append({"name": "B", "kind": "bool"})
campaign = {
  "types": decls,
  "modules": [
    {"name": "deep", "params": [["c", "L0"], ["arr", "Arr"]], "result": ["o", "B"],
     "requires": ["all", "e", ["var", "arr"], ["lt", ["field", ["var", "e"], "v"], ["const", "N", 4096]]]}
  ],
  "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["deep"], "machine": None,
  "runs": []
}
# layout: c -> 58 composites then Leaf: v (2 bytes), w (8 bytes); then arr composite, 4096 * (Leaf composite + v + w)
def leaf_ids(base):
    return base + 1, base + 2, base + 3   # composite, v, w
base = 0
for i in range(DEPTH):
    base += 1
leaf_v, leaf_w, nxt = base + 1, base + 2, base + 3
base += 3
arr_composite = base
base += 1
objs = []
objs.append(("x%d" % leaf_v, enc(1234, 2)))
objs.append(("x%d" % leaf_w, enc((1 << 64) - 1, 8)))
first_leaf = base
objs.append(("x%d" % (first_leaf + 1), enc(0, 2)))
objs.append(("x%d" % (first_leaf + 2), enc(7, 8)))
for i in range(1, 4096):
    objs.append(("x%d" % (first_leaf + 3 * i + 1), enc(i % 4096, 2)))
    objs.append(("x%d" % (first_leaf + 3 * i + 2), enc(i, 8)))
# result o: x = first_leaf + 3*4096
result_id = first_leaf + 3 * 4096
objs.append(("x%d" % result_id, enc(1, 1)))
variables = result_id + 1
sys.stderr.write("variables %d slots %d\n" % (variables, 2 + 1 + 4096 * 2 + 1))
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "deep", "ktest": ktest(objs)}]
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
